name: type:bug
description: Incorrect behavior or regression in an existing capability.

name: type:feature
description: A new user-facing capability or integration.

name: type:improvement
description: Improve existing behavior, performance or architecture.

name: type:maintenance
description: Engineering workflow, tooling, dependencies or test infrastructure.

name: type:documentation
description: Documentation or examples are the primary deliverable.

name: priority:high
description: A blocker or severe impact requiring prompt attention.

name: priority:medium
description: Normal planned work; the default when no urgency is established.

name: priority:low
description: Optional or safely deferrable work.

name: area:playback

name: area:notifications
description: Desktop notifications and notification channel delivery.

name: area:storage
description: Audio cache, temporary files, saved output and cleanup.

name: area:mcp
description: MCP server, tools, schemas and protocol behavior.

name: area:cli
description: Command-line interface, diagnostics and command output.

name: area:configuration
description: Settings, YAML, environment overrides and configuration validation.

name: area:integrations
description: Agent hooks, skills and integration installation.

name: area:testing
description: Test infrastructure, fixtures, coverage and test strategy.

name: area:ci
description: GitHub Actions, builds, packaging and release automation.

name: area:documentation
description: User documentation, contributor guidance and examples.

name: status:needs-info
description: Waiting for specific information needed to investigate or proceed.

name: status:blocked
description: Cannot proceed until a named dependency or blocker is resolved.

name: good first issue
description: Well-scoped work suitable for a first contribution.

name: help wanted
description: Contributions or specialist input are welcome.
